summary: Winema NF site in Klamath County: a 1930s guard station or cab at the base of Pothole Butte, now gone; no source describes what remains.

facts.design: Cab (firelookout.com); FFLOS calls it a guard station at the base of the butte, with a motor trail to the summit
facts.status_note: Both the FFLOS register and firelookout.com say the lookout is gone

events.note: Built in the 1930s; sources give only the decade, so the year is the decade start
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register, US 1035 / OR 393

evidence.supports: Built in the 1930s as a guard station at the base of the butte
evidence.quote: Built in the 1930s, Pothole Butte was a Guard Station located at the base of the butte.

evidence.supports: Motor trail to the summit allowed observation in extreme fire weather
evidence.quote: A motor trail to the summit allowed for observation during times of extreme fire weather.

evidence.supports: Six miles east of Crater Lake
FFLA lists Pothole Butte as Ground, Gone
evidence.quote: Klamath Pothole Butte 42.95061 -121.94191 Ground Gone FFLOS US 1035, OR 393

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLOS register calls it a guard station at the base of the butte with a motor trail to the summit; firelookout.com calls it a cab. The story reports both descriptions.

notes_for_editor: Only two detailed sources, and they describe the structure differently (guard station at the base versus a cab). No staffing, fires or build date beyond the 1930s were found. No source describes the site today or its public access. Brief record checked: coordinates and elevation match FFLOS; kind 'ground' matches the FFLA type label only, and whether the cab stood on the summit is unclear, so the editor may want to check. A cached Oregon Fire Lookouts SW table lists 'Pothole Butte (LO site)', which the table defines as a site where the building has been removed or its status is unknown; its URL was not identified, so it is not cited. Do not use the table's 1931 date: it is the benchmark placement year, not the lookout's build year.
